thread:
Lina: Quick sync: Customer Y requested per-tenant encrypted prefetch + HSM keys for private deploys. Need owners, launch criteria, and sequencing. Can we do pilot in ~6 weeks?

Omar: What are the non-negotiable blockers?

Lina: HSM onboarding & KMS policy, runtime prefixing for encrypted caches, infra prewarm reservations, and audit logging + tests.

Tess: Runtime: prefixing is small but cache migration needs opt-in canary. We'll add tenant flag.

Vik: Infra: can reserve burst slots for pilot. Cost uplift ~7% unless eviction tuned. Need numbers to surface to sales.

Rae: Security: vendor onboarding + policy review =~10 business days. If attestation required, add 2w. Audit schema required.

Lina: Proposed acceptance: <=10% P95 regression, per-tenant billing visibility, HSM ops auditable, 3-5 tenant pilot for 14 days.

Omar: Owners? Lina -> spec, Tess -> runtime toggles, Vik -> infra estimate & quota, Rae -> security checklist, Omar -> perf tests.

Tess: Canary toggle example: {"tenant":"t-99","prefetch":{"enc":true},"canary":true} (will open PR).

Vik: We'll add soft cost cap and billing alert at 120% to prevent surprises.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Reminder: infra maintenance Sat 02:00 UTC; avoid quota changes during window.

Lina: OK. Action items and owners noted. Biggest risk = vendor procurement; fallback = opt-in software KMS with waiver. Any objections?

Rae: Security accepts fallback with explicit customer consent and contract note.

Omar: No objections. I'll prep perf harness and dashboards.

Lina: Thanks everyone 12. I'll share spec link when ready.
